name: anafiles
description: Two seated human musicians facing left play long gold trumpets with red pennants inside a blue rectangular manuscript frame.

name: bird-wind-player
description: A dark bird-like creature with human arms and a pale blue patterned belly plays a long red and gold wind instrument facing left.

name: boar-lute-player
description: An upright blue-gray boar plays a gold lute facing right.

name: bunny-harp
description: An upright brown rabbit facing right plays an orange and gold harp.

name: bunny-trumpet
description: A seated brown rabbit facing left plays a long gold trumpet extending to the left.

name: canine-fiddle-player
description: A canine-headed figure in a blue tunic, red collar, and black boots strides left while playing a bowed fiddle, with its snout tilted upward.

name: crowned-cat
description: A seated cream-colored cat with a long striped tail wears an ornate gold crown and shows a red tongue, looking mostly toward the viewer.

name: curled-cat
description: A brown and gold cat curls into a compact rounded shape with its tail over its body and its face tilted toward the viewer.

name: donkey-organist
description: A seated gray donkey facing right plays a tall gold pipe organ positioned to its right.

name: lizard-lute-player
description: A gold lizard in a blue cap and tunic plays a pink and gold lute facing right, with clawed feet and a tail curving left.

name: fish-with-arms
description: A blue-green fish faces right with two pale human arms raised above its back and red cloth between them.

name: flying-pig
description: A pink pig facing right has large gold feathered wings, a curled tail, and dangling legs.

name: frog
description: A broad green frog with dark spots crouches facing left.

name: hooded-bagpiper
description: A standing human facing right wears a pointed red-orange hood and tunic with green lining and black shoes, playing pale bagpipes with a long pipe extending left.

name: musician-r1-c1-organ-player
description: A seated human facing right wears a patterned cream cap, red sleeves, and a brown robe, holding small vertical organ pipes and gesturing right.

name: musician-r1-c2-shawm-player
description: A standing human facing right wears a cream cap, dark blue tunic, and red stockings, playing a long straight gold shawm extending right.

name: musician-r1-c3-horn-player
description: A seated human facing right wears a pointed red and blue cap and a red-brown tunic, playing a pale curved horn pointing upward to the right.

name: musician-r1-c4-horn-player
description: A seated human facing left wears a cream cap and long red robe, playing a pale curved horn extending left.

name: musician-r2-c1-bagpiper
description: A seated human facing right wears a dark blue cape with gold trim, red sleeves, and a cream cap and collar, playing pale bagpipes with a curved pipe extending right.

name: musician-r2-c2-bagpiper
description: A standing human facing right wears a green tunic, red sleeves, blue stockings, and a cream cap, playing pale gold bagpipes held against the chest.

name: musician-r2-c3-horn-player
description: A seated human facing right wears a dark blue robe and cream cap, playing a large gold-green horn that curves upward to the right.

name: musician-r2-c4-psaltery-player
description: A seated human in a dark robe and patterned cap looks down toward the left while playing a large gold psaltery held diagonally across the lap.

name: musician-r3-c1-bagpiper
description: A standing human facing right wears a green tunic, red sleeves and stockings, and a cream cap, playing a red patterned bagpipe with long green pipes extending left and right.

name: musician-r3-c2-lute-player
description: A standing human wears a tilted green cap, red striped tunic, and long green robe, looking down toward the right while playing a pale lute extending right.

name: musician-r3-c3-lute-player
description: A standing brown-haired human wears a red jacket, dark blue dotted skirt, and red stockings, looking down toward the left while playing a pale lute with its neck pointing up-right.

name: musician-r3-c4-pipe-player
description: A seated curly-haired human facing right wears a pale blue and cream striped sleeveless outfit and red stockings, playing a short straight gold pipe.

name: rabbit-bagpiper
description: An upright gray rabbit faces left while playing pale round bagpipes, with a short pipe on the left and a very long gold pipe extending right.

name: donkey-rooster-lute-player
description: A half-donkey, half-rooster hybrid facing right wears an orange tunic and black waist pouch, with a gray donkey head, gold rooster legs, and a green feathered tail, playing a gold lute.

name: seated-rabbit
description: A tired-looking seated cream-colored rabbit faces right with tall ears, a half-closed eye, blue-green hindquarters and legs, and a thick black outline.

name: snail
description: An orange-brown snail faces right with long feelers and a large brown spiral shell.

name: weird-dog
description: A seated shaggy dog-like creature has a human-like bearded face looking toward the viewer, dark paws, and a long curled tail.

name: white-animal-bagpiper
description: A seated pale animal-like creature with rounded ears, a long curled tail, and hand-like forelimbs faces the viewer while playing gold bagpipes.

name: winged-rabbit
description: A blue-gray rabbit-like hybrid faces right with large brown feathered wings, a long feathered tail extending left, and clawed feet.

name: animal-musicians-ensemble
description: A complete framed manuscript scene on green grass with a patterned blue, gold, and pink background: animals gather around an open score, a bowed string player, a donkey at a pipe organ, white geese, a red animal with bagpipes and a drum, a pale animal ringing bells, and a harp lying on the ground.

name: animal-choir-landscape
description: A herd of cattle and a small hoofed animal face left toward a wooden music stand with an open score, with two small birds flying above and a narrow greenish ground strip beneath the full group.

name: rabbit-reading-book
description: A brown rabbit with tall ears and a wide white eye leans left over an open pale book, with a paw resting on the marked pages.

name: cat-reading-book
description: A seated blue-gray cat with a long striped tail and thin whiskers tilts its head up-right beside an open pale book, with a paw on the pages.

name: creature-in-gold-shape
description: A pale grotesque creature with a round face, dark mouthpiece-like object, raised arm, large curved pale body, and curling appendages sits within a curved gold form with a pointed upper-right extension.

name: funny-faced-lying-cat
description: A lying orange-brown tabby cat faces the viewer with tucked front paws, tall triangular ears, broad eyes, and a funny almost human-looking expression in a softly textured painting.

name: hooded-harp-player
description: A standing human facing left wears a tall blue hood, gold tunic, black leggings, and black shoes, playing a large gold harp held to the right.

name: musicians-and-dancers
description: A bagpiper and two figures with a suspended gold drum accompany four dancers on a blue patterned platform with red and gold edges, beside a curling green vine with red, blue, and gold leaves at the left.
